props.name: value
props.description: The real value. Only rendered while it is revealed.

props.name: label
props.description: What it is — "Account number", "Card number". Used in every announcement.

props.name: hideAfter
props.description: Milliseconds before it hides itself again. 0 keeps it shown.

props.name: group
props.description: Group the revealed value — 4 for a card number, 0 to leave it alone.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Offer a copy button. Copying never reveals.

props.name: copyValue
props.description: Copy this instead of `value` — the unformatted form, usually.
